blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The existence of Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged dollar-denominated bank accounts has raised the possibility that she has additional financial assets beyond those already examined in the P817.87 million alleged unexplained wealth case, according to the House prosecution panel in her ongoing impeachment trial. House trial spokesperson and Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong, pointed out that the foreign currency accounts were not included in the financial records underlying the remaining impeachment charge. “At ’yung dollar accounts ang nagpapatunay na mayroon pang mga possible na asset o yaman na hindi pa naideklara o hindi nasali sa complaint […]...
